title: gh-hush configuration
description: Policy used by gh-hush to decide which GitHub notifications to keep and hush.

user.description: GitHub login that must match the account authenticated by gh.

github_organization.description: Primary GitHub organization. Notifications outside it are protected when external_organization_issues is enabled.

team_slugs.description: Teams used by team review and Discussion mention rules, in org/team-slug form. Each org must match github_organization; matching and uniqueness are case-insensitive.

keep.description: Explicit protection rules. Every switch is required and may be disabled with false.

external_organization_issues.description: Keep notifications for all subject types in repositories outside github_organization.

personally_mentioned.description: Keep notifications caused by a personal mention.

personally_assigned.description: Keep Issues and pull requests currently assigned to user.

individually_review_requested.description: Keep pull requests with a current review request for user.

active_team_review_requested_pull_reques.description: Keep open pull requests with a current review request for a configured team.

team_mentioned_discussions.description: Keep Discussions whose body or comment history mentions a configured team.

hush.description: Catch-all action applied after keep rules.

all_other_notifications.description: Unsubscribe from and mark Done all eligible notifications not protected by a keep rule. Must be true.
